answer: We define a cryptoeconomic primitive where each identity requires a staking collateral bond verified by zero-knowledge verifiable delays. To scale the computational ridge of identity generation, an adversary embarking on a malicious voyage must allocate capital that yields a strictly negative expected utility. Under a subgame-perfect slashing matrix, any detected duplication triggers penalties that drain this ocean of collateral, proving that the unique Nash equilibrium converges to honest play.
